user.title: Home Hub check-in
user.description: When this Home Assistant comes online (for example the first time it's plugged in at a new house), it sends a message to the check-in address so the person looking after it knows. It keeps trying until the message gets through.

data_description.url: The webhook address on your own Home Assistant, for example https://example.duckdns.org:8123/api/webhook/…
data_description.remote: How you reach this Home Assistant over Tailscale, for example http://home-hub-yusuf:8123. It's included in the message.

error.bad_url: Enter a full address starting with http:// or https://
